summary.en: Build string operations with loops, trace their bounds, and handle empty text without unsigned underflow.
summary.bn: লুপ দিয়ে স্ট্রিংয়ের কাজ করো, ইনডেক্সের সীমা দেখো আর খালি স্ট্রিংও ঠিকভাবে সামলাও।

notes: The string and character rules used here are unchanged in C17. C99 permits the size_t loop declarations shown. C23 does not make byte reversal Unicode-aware or add automatic bounds checks to these ordinary arrays.

examples.title: Length and copy by hand
examples.explanationHtml: Six bytes are copied before the final zero is written. The known destination is large enough.

examples.title: Append and compare with loops
examples.explanationHtml: The append leaves one slot free. The comparison stops at a difference or the shared terminator.

examples.title: Reverse a course token
examples.explanationHtml: One outer-pair swap produces ESC. The n/2 bound avoids calculating n-1 for an empty string.

examples.title: Count words and vowels
examples.explanationHtml: Repeated spaces do not create extra words. Lowercasing makes the initial A count as a vowel.

examples.title: Normalize ASCII letter case
examples.explanationHtml: Letters become uppercase while the space and digits stay the same.

practice.title: Reverse an ASCII line
practice.statementHtml: Read an ASCII line of 0 to 80 characters and newline. Print Line: then its reversed text.
hints: Swap indices i and n-1-i only while i is below n/2.

practice.title: Recognize exact palindromes
practice.statementHtml: Read a line of 0 to 80 ASCII characters and newline. Print Line: then YES if the complete case-sensitive byte sequence is a palindrome, otherwise NO.
hints: Empty and one-character lines have no unequal pair.

practice.title: Count space-delimited words
practice.statementHtml: Read an ASCII line of 0 to 80 characters and newline. Print Line: then the number of maximal non-whitespace runs.
hints: Track whether the previous character was inside a word.

practice.title: Write a checked hand-built join
practice.statementHtml: Read two ASCII tokens of 1 to 30 bytes. Print Tokens: then their concatenation if it fits char result[41], else FULL. Do not use strcpy or strcat.
hints: The second loop can include the source terminator after the size check.

quiz.prompt: Where should a manual copy write its final null after copying n visible bytes?
quiz.explanation: The first unused element follows indices zero through n-1.

quiz.prompt: Why does the reverse loop use i < n/2?
options: It ignores the final half permanently
quiz.explanation: The other half moves during the same swaps; the middle byte stays put.

quiz.prompt: Which comparison order matches strcmp for bytes with the high bit set?
quiz.explanation: The standard byte-string comparison uses unsigned character values.

quiz.prompt: What event starts a new word in a whitespace-run counter?
options: A nonspace byte following whitespace or the beginning
quiz.explanation: A state flag avoids counting repeated separators as words.

quiz.prompt: Is reversing arbitrary UTF-8 with individual char swaps sound?
options: Yes, all encodings use one byte
No, it can break multibyte characters
quiz.explanation: A multibyte character requires its constituent bytes to remain in their encoding order.

quiz.prompt: How should an empty string behave in the shown palindrome definition?
options: Its result depends on array capacity
quiz.explanation: There are no opposing characters that disagree.

options: A negative plain char is outside the permitted argument domain
quiz.explanation: ctype accepts EOF or an unsigned-char-representable value.

quiz.prompt: What length accompanies the hand-copied course code?
quiz.explanation: The loop counts each visible byte before adding termination.

quiz.prompt: What sequence appears after swapping the outer bytes of CSE?
quiz.explanation: The middle S stays in place.

quiz.prompt: Which characters change during case normalization of Lab 204?
quiz.explanation: Only the alphabetic bytes change under the initial C locale.

keyPoints.en: Copying a string includes its zero terminator.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রিং কপি করলে শেষের null ক্যারেক্টারও কপি করতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Reverse swaps stop halfway through the visible bytes.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রিং উল্টানোর সময় অর্ধেক পর্যন্ত জোড়া বদলালেই চলে।

keyPoints.en: An empty string is a palindrome under the chosen definition.
keyPoints.bn: এখানে খালি স্ট্রিংকেও প্যালিনড্রোম ধরা হয়েছে।

keyPoints.en: Word counts increase on transitions into nonspace text.
keyPoints.bn: স্পেসের পর শব্দ শুরু হলে ওয়ার্ড কাউন্ট বাড়ে।

examQuestions.question: Design an O(n) palindrome test and explain why it is safe for an empty string.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Measure n, then compare positions i and n-1-i while i<n/2. Report false at the first mismatch. With n=0, the loop never enters, so n-1-i is never evaluated. The test uses O(1) extra storage and compares exact bytes, not normalized Unicode letters.

LAB 204

Only the alphabetic bytes change under the initial C locale.

examQuestions.question: Read two ASCII tokens of 1 to 30 bytes. Print Tokens: then their concatenation if it fits char result[41], else FULL. Do not use strcpy or strcat.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    char a[31], b[31], result[41];
    puts("Tokens:");
    if (scanf("%30s %30s", a, b) != 2) {
        return 1;
    }
    size_t n = 0, m = 0;
    while (a[n] != '\0') {
        n++;
    }
    while (b[m] != '\0') {
        m++;
    }
    if (n + m >= sizeof result) {
        puts("FULL");
        return 0;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        result[i] = a[i];
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        result[n + i] = b[i];
    }
    puts(result);
    return 0;
}

The second loop can include the source terminator after the size check.
